gloss: worthy rival; good opponent; well-matched competitor

definitions.gloss: worthy rival; good opponent; well-matched competitor
definitions.explanation: A rival or competitor whose skill level closely matches one's own, making the competition both challenging and stimulating. Implies mutual respect between competitors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is a worthy rival to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{互|たが}い→互い：03402_tagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{高|たか}め{合|あ}ってきた。
examples.english: The two have pushed each other to improve as long-time rivals.

examples.japanese: よい{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}がいた⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧、⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think it was precisely because I had a good rival that I was able to grow this much.

notes:
USAGE:
{好敵手|こうてきしゅ} has a positive connotation. It implies that the rivalry brings out the best in both parties. The ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧ (rival) loanword is more common in casual speech, while {好敵手|こうてきしゅ} is more literary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好敵手|こうてきしゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧ (to compete with a worthy rival)
- ⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好敵手|こうてきしゅ} (a lifelong rival)
- {好敵手|こうてきしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧ (to be blessed with a good rival)

ETYMOLOGY:
{好|こう} (good, favorable) + {敵手|てきしゅ} (opponent). Literally "a good opponent" — someone whose opposition is welcome because it drives improvement.
